title: Kite with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='kiteGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5b7f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9a3c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bowGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#42c8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7a6bff'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail string -->
  <path d='M50 74 Q48 82 52 88 Q56 93 60 96' stroke='#ffd34d' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- bows on tail -->
  <path d='M52 82 L46 78 L46 86 Z' fill='url(#bowGrad)'/>
  <path d='M52 82 L58 78 L58 86 Z' fill='url(#bowGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='82' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M57 91 L51 87 L51 95 Z' fill='#42c8ff'/>
  <path d='M57 91 L63 87 L63 95 Z' fill='#42c8ff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='91' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- kite body: diamond -->
  <path d='M50 12 L84 46 L50 74 L16 46 Z' fill='url(#kiteGrad)'/>
  <!-- spine highlight for edge definition -->
  <path d='M50 12 L50 74' stroke='#ffd34d' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M16 46 L84 46' stroke='#ffd34d' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <!-- smiling face -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='3.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='3.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M38 52 Q50 62 62 52' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
